Steaks & Grills: Pepper-crusted steaks, charcoal-grilled beef and skewers seasoned with yaji.
Biscuits: From crisp tea biscuits to flaky, buttery breakfast bakes.
Fried Rice: Rice from the wok and frying pan, from Nigerian party rice to spring onion and egg.

the-burger-house.name: Chargrilled Ribeye Steak
the-burger-house.description: A ribeye seared over high heat until the fat at its edges turns crisp, served with charred asparagus.

the-burger-house.name: Buttermilk Biscuits
the-burger-house.description: Cold butter folded into the dough gives these American breakfast biscuits their flaky layers.

maison-laurent.name: Steak au Poivre
maison-laurent.description: Crushed peppercorns form a crust on the beef; cream and pan juices soften their bite in the sauce.

ember-court.name: Yaji-Rubbed Sirloin Steak
ember-court.description: A sirloin rubbed with house yaji, rested after grilling and plated with crisp potato wedges.

ember-court.name: Beef Suya Skewers
ember-court.description: Thin strips of beef take a groundnut-and-spice coating before a quick turn over hot coals.

ember-court.name: Chilli Mi Goreng Indomie
ember-court.description: Dry-style fried noodles tossed with sweet soy, chilli and shallots rather than served in broth.

ember-court.name: Miyan Kuka
ember-court.description: Powdered baobab leaves thicken the stock into a smooth, earthy soup, served in the northern Nigerian tradition.

saffron-room.name: Butter Shortbread Biscuits
saffron-room.description: Pale, buttery fingers baked just until their edges colour, with a sandy crumb that melts into tea.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Ginger Snap Biscuits
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: Thin biscuits spiced with ground ginger, crisp enough to snap when broken in two.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Chicken Indomie with Boiled Egg
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: Chicken-flavour Indomie cooked until springy, topped with boiled egg and sliced vegetables.

copper-ladle-breakfast-club.name: Onion Chicken Indomie
copper-ladle-breakfast-club.description: Onion Chicken noodles tossed with sweet onions and carrot, with egg added at the table.

bella-napoli.name: Espresso Tiramisu
bella-napoli.description: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream, finished with an unsweetened dusting of cocoa.

atelier-du-soir.name: Molten Chocolate Fondant
atelier-du-soir.description: A small dark chocolate cake baked to set the edges while the centre stays warm and fluid.

the-garri-bowl.name: Nutmeg Chin Chin
the-garri-bowl.description: Tiny squares of nutmeg-scented dough fried until golden and crunchy, served by the handful.

the-garri-bowl.name: Ewedu Soup
the-garri-bowl.description: Jute leaves are beaten to a silky consistency and seasoned with iru; order a bowl alongside amala.

spice-garden.name: Garden Pepper Indomie
spice-garden.description: A house variation: curly noodles stir-fried with sweet peppers, onions and a little fresh chilli.

spice-garden.name: Jollof-Style Indomie
spice-garden.description: The kitchen's tomato-and-pepper base coats the noodles, finished with small pieces of browned liver.

spice-garden.name: Nigerian Party Fried Rice
spice-garden.description: Stock-seasoned rice is stir-fried in small batches with diced vegetables and gizzard, then served with chicken.

waterleaf-courtyard.name: Fresh Fish Banga Soup
waterleaf-courtyard.description: Palm fruit extract forms a deep orange broth. Fresh fish cooks gently in it until tender, ready for scooping up with eba.

waterleaf-courtyard.name: Prawn & Okro Soup
waterleaf-courtyard.description: Chopped okra thickens the broth while prawns and ground crayfish give it a savoury finish.

waterleaf-courtyard.name: Coconut Fried Rice
waterleaf-courtyard.description: Rice cooked with coconut milk is cooled, then tossed with diced vegetables until the grains turn glossy.

ugba-clay.name: Ogbono Soup with Beef
ugba-clay.description: Ground ogbono seeds give the stock its characteristic draw. Tender beef and cow skin add a contrast in texture.

red-pepper-courtyard.name: Spring Onion Egg Fried Rice
red-pepper-courtyard.description: Cooled rice hits a hot wok with soft ribbons of egg and spring onion until the grains separate.

tamarind-soi.name: Prawn Fried Rice
tamarind-soi.description: Prawns are flash-seared before rice and aromatics are tossed through the wok, with lime to finish.
